export-all.body:
kind: NotificationChannel
key: ops-slack
name: Ops Slack
type: slack
enabled: true
notifyOnRecovery: true
config:
  webhookUrl: ••••••••
  text: "Down: {{monitor_name}}"
alertPolicy:
  quietHours:
    enabled: false
    start: "22:00"
    end: "07:00"
    timezone: UTC
    mode: defer
  throttle:
    enabled: false
    maxAlerts: 3
    windowMinutes: 60
  grouping:
    enabled: false
    minMonitors: 3
    windowSeconds: 60
---
kind: NotificationChannel
key: tg
name: Telegram bot
type: telegram
enabled: false
notifyOnRecovery: false
config:
  chatId: "-100500"
  vault:
    vault: Production
    secret: bot-token
alertPolicy:
  quietHours:
    enabled: true
    start: "22:00"
    end: "07:00"
    timezone: Europe/Warsaw
    mode: suppress
  throttle:
    enabled: true
    maxAlerts: 3
    windowMinutes: 30
  grouping:
    enabled: false
    minMonitors: 3
    windowSeconds: 60
---
kind: Action
key: start-vm2
name: Start VM2
enabled: true
config:
  url: https://jenkins.test/job/vm2/build
  method: POST
  headers:
    Authorization: ••••••••
    X-Note: plain
  secrets:
    - name: jenkins
      vault:
        vault: Jenkins
        secret: api-token
notifications:
  - ops-slack
---
kind: Monitor
key: billing-db
name: Billing DB
type: postgresql
intervalSecs: 60
timeoutMs: 10000
retries: 1
failureThreshold: 1
recoveryThreshold: 1
config:
  host: db.internal
  port: 5432
  database: billing
  user: app
  password: ••••••••
  query: select 1
  mode: fields
tags: []
notifications: []
dependsOn: []
actions: []
---
kind: Monitor
key: nightly-job
name: Nightly job
type: webhook
intervalSecs: 60
timeoutMs: 10000
retries: 1
failureThreshold: 1
recoveryThreshold: 1
config: {}
tags: []
heartbeatToken: ••••••••
notifications: []
dependsOn: []
actions: []
---
kind: Monitor
key: public-site
name: Public site
type: https
intervalSecs: 30
timeoutMs: 10000
retries: 1
failureThreshold: 1
recoveryThreshold: 1
config:
  url: https://example.test
  method: GET
  expectedStatus: 200
  headers:
    Authorization: ••••••••
    Accept: application/json
  auth:
    type: basic
    basic:
      username: svc
      password: ••••••••
tags:
  - label: prod
    color: "#00ff00"
notifications:
  - ops-slack
  - tg
dependsOn:
  - billing-db
actions: []
---
kind: Monitor
key: vm1
name: VM1 SQL
type: sqlserver
intervalSecs: 60
timeoutMs: 10000
retries: 1
failureThreshold: 1
recoveryThreshold: 1
config:
  host: vm1.internal
  port: 1433
  database: app
  user: sa
  password: ••••••••
  query: SELECT 1
  mode: fields
tags: []
notifications: []
dependsOn: []
actions:
  - action: start-vm2
    onStatus: down
    delayMinutes: 5
    cooldownMinutes: 60
autoIncident:
  afterMinutes: 5
  mode: draft
